hypothesis: Replacing liquid electrolyte with a solid electrolyte in perovskite-sensitized DSSCs will increase stability
prediction: Perovskite-sensitized DSSCs with solid electrolyte will show higher stability than those with liquid electrolyte
measurement_method: Compare stability metrics (e.g., operational lifetime or efficiency retention after fixed time) between perovskite DSSCs with solid vs. liquid electrolytes
falsification_condition: Perovskite-sensitized DSSCs with solid electrolyte show equal or lower stability than those with liquid electrolyte
